description.en: Convert CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy (Tencent coding assistant) subscription into an OpenAI-compatible API. Use CodeBuddy GLM-5.2/Kimi/DeepSeek models in Codex CLI or any OpenAI client. Cross-platform, single-file, no auth changes.
description.zh: 将 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy 订阅转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持在 Codex CLI 等客户端使用。

audience.zh: 使用 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy 的开发者

usecases.zh: 将 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy 订阅转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API
usecases.en: Convert CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy subscription to OpenAI-compatible API
